TaskDescription: Sit-to-stand and stand-to-sit transitions performed under both motor execution and motor imagery conditions; trigger codes at channel 63 mark each transition/rest event. MI: two rounds of 10 trials per task per session (readme index table). Trial duration: 4.0s.
InstitutionName: Vidyasirimedhi Institute of Science and Technology
Description: First public EEG dataset explicitly targeting sit-to-stand and stand-to-sit transitions during motor execution and motor imagery, from 22 healthy participants with 60-channel EEG, EOG and EMG.
